test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who was the architect of the famous Mysore Palace in Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Henry Irwin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Henry Irwin was an architect of British India.**
 
• He is generally popular for his works in the **Indo-Saracenic style of architecture.**
 
• Henry Irwin was the **architect of the popular Mysore Palace in Karnataka**.
 
• He was rewarded in the **1888 Birthday** Honors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fredrik William Stevens**' most notable design was the railway station Victoria Terminus in Bombay.​
 
• **Sir William Emerson** was a British architect. 
 
• **Edwin Lutyens** is famous mainly for his planning of New Delhi and his design of the Viceroy's House there.
